verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is community reports that teams can have discussions in the comment space on the back of a Trello card, inside the planning tool itself. That is threaded card discussion, not evidenced real-time team chat, and no first-party doc describes it. The Slack capture into the Trello Inbox only imports content and earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-product messaging or comments, real-time chat or direct messaging beyond card-level threads, notifications/mentions, independent corroboration of chat depth.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: You could have a real discussion on the back of the card.
